c74object.name: gst.riot-comote
c74object.digest: Input data interface for Ircam IMU receiver modules
c74object.description: gst.riot-comote is an input data interface for Ircam IMU receiver modules. It is compatible with RIoT IMU modules (RIoT2 and v3) and with smartphone application CoMo.te (Apple Store and Google Play) : video and more inofrmation. It relies on sending Open Sound Control ( OSC ) messages via UDP over Ethernet. Check available port with you Operating System (Mac OS ). gst.riot-comote uses internal send/receive to spread resampling clock informations : frameperiod, framerate and sync messages.

inlet.description: OSC id number is specified in your IMU device (RIoT) or CoMo.te application.
Port number is specified in your IMU device (RIoT) or CoMo.te application. It must be an available port of your OS in order to assigned to Max application.
